scope: Proposition 6.2 (Gale cohomology supply) of the manuscript “Abelian covers, Gale correspondences, and the Hodge conjecture for powers” (preprints/Abelian-covers-Gale-correspondences-and-the-Hodge-conjecture-for-powers-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3467c8077855a568), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let P ∈ Ud,m. For each S ⊂ {1, . . . , m} with s = |S| ≥ d + 2, put PS = prS P, QS = P⊥ S , YS = XQS , hS = s − d − 2. There is a rational algebraic correspondence from Fs−2 n × YS to XP , with degree shift −2hS, whose image after scalar extension contains WP,b for every character with support S. Together with hyperplane cycles from a point, these finitely many maps span the full rational cohomology of XP . In the middle degree the source maps may be taken on the entire groups Hd+2hS (Fs−2 n × YS, Q)(hS).
